title: CDE Sr. Solutions Architect, Software and Technology
description_html:
Join the AWS Solutions Architecture team as a Customer Deployed Engineer SA for Software and Technology customers. Our customers are born in the cloud and are leading the industry in AI-Native transformation. You will define and prove technical direction by combining architectural reasoning and strategic advisory with hands-on validation in customer environments. You will build working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate customer decisions and remove the gap between architectural recommendation and validated proof.  You operate where the path forward is undefined and must be defined by you. Your customers have business objectives but may not have defined technology strategy or solution design. You create and adapt approaches for situations where established patterns are insufficient, applying contextual judgment about your customers' operational constraints, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics.  You will be the primary technical partner for your customers. You lead with Agentic AI and AI-assisted development to solve customer problems, and you steer customers away from where hype outpaces practical value for their operational context. You maintain technical currency so customers receive guidance based on current capability, not outdated expertise. You build deep relationships with customers’ senior technical leaders to enable them to be cloud advocates.  You are technically self-sufficient, yet you know when to seek help: you are capable of using AI tools and delivering directly in customer sandbox environments. You drive the architectural decisions that downstream teams (customer engineering, ProServe, partners) build against, and you own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting.

   Key job responsibilities  
Technical Proof & Validation  
* Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Bedrock) to validate architectural recommendations and accelerate customer adoption  
• Implement directly to unblock customer decisions: build PoCs proving architectural approaches that conversations alone cannot validate  
• Deploy infrastructure using IaC (CDK, Terraform) in customer sandboxes, demonstrating scalability and security patterns  
• Apply GenAI and agentic systems (multi-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, foundation model integration) where they solve customer problems.   

Architectural Reasoning & Decision Ownership
 • Frame and resolve technical trade-offs involving multiple competing concerns (security vs. cost vs. operational burden vs. time-to-market vs. industry compliance), bringing a clear recommendation with alternatives articulated  
• Make cross-cutting architectural decisions that ensure coherence across systems, teams, and workstreams; flag decisions that are difficult to reverse before the customer commits  
• Diagnose non-obvious architectural issues including resilience gaps, failover weaknesses, scaling bottlenecks, and security vulnerabilities specific to industrial IoT and construction technology environments  
• Own the architectural decisions that downstream teams build against and own the consequences with the customer when those decisions need revisiting  • Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the architecture holds against the reality of the customer's environment; know when accumulated context warrants a revised approach   Strategic

Advisory & Customer Influence
 • Own the end-to-end technical strategy for assigned customers, maintaining the current view of their technical landscape, industry context, and competitive dynamics
 • Partner with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
 • Influence senior leaders' technology direction by connecting short-term AI and cloud decisions to long-term business outcomes; earn trust through guidance that consistently delivers the outcomes they expected  • Challenge customer direction when evidence indicates a better path; customers avoid costly rework because you identify risk early and bring considered alternatives  
• Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex capabilities into business-outcome narratives   Revenue & Opportunity Acceleration  
• Accelerate customer adoption by removing ambiguity through validated proof points, measurably reducing the time from architectural recommendation to customer commitment  
• Identify new opportunities discovered during customer engagements
 • Increase service adoption through tangible multi-service integration demos  
• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
 • Identify implementation pathways that benefit from ProServe expertise, creating natural expansion opportunities through demonstrated value   

Customer Relationship & Communication Skills  
• Experience presenting to both large and small audiences (Executives, IT Management, and developers)  
• Experience communicating across internal and external organizations  
• Ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience
 • Ability to pick up on non-verbal communication and "un-said" drivers   

Thought Leadership & Product Influence
 • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as blogs and whitepapers.  
• Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable requirements that service teams act on; synthesize evidence across multiple engagements rather than relaying feedback from one. Accelerate development and reduce ambiguity by creating code for a proposed feature to illustrate your requirement that can be reviewed and evaluated for inclusion into product codebase.

title: HPC Platform Engineer, Software, Center for Quantum Computing
description_html:
The Models, Quantum, & Silicon (MQS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and technicians, on a mission to develop a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

We are looking to hire an HPC Platform Engineer to develop, automate, and maintain high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure on AWS that CQC scientists and engineers use for quantum computing hardware design and simulation. You will work closely with our experimental and theoretical physics teams to enable large-scale HPC workloads with MPI-based parallelism on EC2 instances, manage graphical environments for computer-aided engineering applications, and accelerate the research computing lifecycle through automation and infrastructure-as-code. The ideal candidate will be able to translate high-level science and simulation requirements into reliable deliverables (including cluster orchestration, job scheduling, CI/CD pipelines, reproducible environments, and artifact management) that are performant, scalable, and secure. This requires someone who (1) has a strong desire to work within a team of scientists and engineers, (2) demonstrates ownership by initiating and driving projects to completion, and (3) is comfortable operating at the intersection of traditional HPC and cloud-native infrastructure.

Why MQS?
Models, Quantum, & Silicon is a brand new organization within Amazon. We're building the full stack of compute to power the next era of innovation. One Org. One Mission. Limitless Impact!

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at MQS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include some combination of the following:

* Administer and automate cloud-based HPC environments by deploying and maintaining clusters, managing OS and software stacks, building containers, provisioning users, and securing systems.
* Support computer-aided engineering and computational science workflows (e.g., Palace) by improving HPC environment robustness, performance, and availability across instance types and regions.
* Anticipate and expand CQC computational capacity, leveraging AWS to accelerate the quantum hardware design cycle.
* Design reproducible development environments and own dependency, build, and release management across interdependent research software projects.
* Develop CI/CD pipelines and automate provisioning using infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Docker, AWS CDK).
* Maintain Amazon's high security bar while enabling fast-paced development; implement observability and monitoring for rapid debugging and high uptime.

We are looking for candidates with strong engineering principles, a bias for action, superior problem-solving, and excellent communication skills. Working effectively within a team environment is essential. As an HPC Platform Engineer embedded in a research organization, you will have the opportunity to work on new ideas and stay abreast of the field of experimental quantum computation.


A day in the life
The majority of your time will be spent on projects that strengthen and scale our HPC platform and accelerate the computational workflows that underpin quantum hardware design. This requires working backwards from the needs of our science staff in the context of our larger experimental roadmap. You will translate science and software requirements into design proposals, balancing implementation complexity against time-to-delivery. Once a proposal has been reviewed and accepted, you'll drive implementation and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth rollout. You will work closely with engineers and scientists on the team to understand their simulation workloads, parallelism requirements, and tooling needs.

About the team
You will be joining the Software team within the MQS Center of Quantum Computing. Our team is comprised of scientists and engineers who are building scalable software that enables quantum computing technologies. - Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience using infrastructure-as-code to design and deploy cloud services - Experience with distributed systems at scale
- Experience in an AWS environment, including VPC, EC2, EBS, S3, SQS, CloudFormation and Lambda
- Experience in network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, HTTP)
- Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem
- Experience working with scientists in a research environment
- Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure

title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Infrastructure Engineering Systems
description_html: Overview   The AI Infrastructure Engineering Systems team at Microsoft builds the cloud platform, engineering infrastructure, and developer systems that enable teams to develop, deploy, and operate AI services at scale. We create foundational capabilities spanning build and release systems, Kubernetes, networking, observability, infrastructure automation, security, and service lifecycle management. Working closely with AI researchers, product engineers, and hardware teams, we provide reliable and consistent paths from development to production. We are a multidisciplinary team of highly capable and motivated engineers with a collaborative and inclusive culture.     As a Principal Software Engineer - AI Infrastructure Engineering Systems on the AI Infra Engineering Systems team, you will design, implement, and ensure the quality of engineering platforms, developer tooling, and Azure integrations. This hands-on technical role covers architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
